_readme: Playwright download sources. Copy to data/download-sources.json.
1. Only hosts in allowedHosts are ever navigated to or downloaded from.
2. If a click leads to another host, the job stops with HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.
3. There is no shortlink/ad-gateway/captcha bypass — if the file does not
start from an allowlisted page, the command reports an error.
Use this only for a site you own or are licensed to distribute from.
Do not point it at a site that hosts films you do not have rights to.
SELECTORS: open the site in Chrome, right-click the element → Inspect.
resultSelector   → each search result link (e.g. '.results a.title')
downloadSelector → the download button on the detail page
detail.title     → the h1 on the detail page (optional)
NOTE: if the download button opens a popup tab, the module still catches
the download event (it listens on the browser context as well).
